title: Toddler Boy with Easter Basket, Yard Shed - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black-and-white snapshot depicts a young toddler boy standing on a lawn beside a white shingled outbuilding or house. He is dressed in a neatly buttoned cardigan sweater and trousers, looking intently down at a woven handle basket containing Easter eggs. Bright sunlight casts sharp shadows across the grass, accompanied by a soft lens flare at the lower left, reflecting a classic mid-century family Easter tradition.
